source_extracts.label: AT&T 21-day return window and non-return fee
source_extracts.quote: To avoid a non-return fee, make sure you return all required equipment within 21 days of your service change or disconnect. ... $150 for a Wi-Fi or All-Fi Gateway $200 for an All-Fi Hub $65 for ...

source_extracts.label: AT&T return locations and drop-box prohibition
source_extracts.quote: Take your unpacked equipment and account number to a company-owned FedEx Office Pack & Ship or The UPS Store. Have a store rep scan your equipment and get a tracking receipt. They'll pack and ship it. Don't drop your equipment in a drop box.

source_extracts.label: AT&T return start phone number
source_extracts.quote: Have your account number handy and call us at 800.288.2020 to start your equipment return or move to a new location.

source_extracts.label: AT&T equipment lists by service (Internet & Fiber vs Internet Air)
source_extracts.quote: AT&T Internet & AT&T Fiber — What to return: All-Fi Hub: BGW320, BGW210; Wi-Fi Extender: AirTies 4971, AirTies 4991; Power supply. AT&T Internet Air — All-Fi Hub: BGW830, BGW530, CGW450; All-Fi Extender: AirTies 4971, AirTies 4981; Power supply.

source_extracts.label: AT&T wall-mounted equipment and owned gear stay
source_extracts.quote: What not to return: Wall-mounted equipment like Ethernet jacks, Fiber jacks, or Optical Network Terminals (ONTs) ... Equipment you own, 3rd-party (non-AT&T) extenders, HDMI cables, or Ethernet cables. FYI: Don't remove or unplug wall-mounted equipment.

source_extracts.label: AT&T damaged-equipment fee
source_extracts.quote: If the returned equipment is damaged due to abuse, we may add a damaged equipment fee to your bill.

source_extracts.label: AT&T Internet consumer fee schedule — non-return equipment fee amounts
source_extracts.quote: Non-Return Equipment Fee ... $150 $200 ... If you fail to return the AT&T Home Wi-Fi Gateway or the AT&T All-Fi Hub after canceling your Internet Service.
